# Goals

```fieldnotes-view
{"version":1,"view":"custom","query":{"where":[{"field":"frontmatter.type","operator":"eq","value":"goal"}],"includeTrash":true},"js":"const rows = notes.map(note => `<li><strong>${escapeHtml(note.title)}</strong> <span>${escapeHtml(note.frontmatter.status || 'active')}</span><form><input type=\"hidden\" name=\"frontmatterPatch\" value=\"{&quot;status&quot;:&quot;completed&quot;}\"><button type=\"submit\" data-fn-event=\"note.update\" data-note-id=\"${note.id}\">Complete</button></form><button type=\"button\" data-fn-event=\"note.trash\" data-note-id=\"${note.id}\">Trash</button></li>`).join(''); const restore = trash.map(note => `<li>${escapeHtml(note.title)} <button type=\"button\" data-fn-event=\"trash.restore\" data-note-id=\"${note.id}\">Restore</button></li>`).join(''); return { html: `<section class=\"goals-board\"><h2>Active goals</h2><form class=\"goal-create\" data-fn-event=\"note.create\"><label>New goal title<input name=\"title\" aria-label=\"New goal title\" placeholder=\"Enter a goal\" value=\"A new synthetic goal\"></label><input type=\"hidden\" name=\"frontmatter\" value=\"{&quot;type&quot;:&quot;goal&quot;,&quot;status&quot;:&quot;active&quot;}\"><button type=\"submit\">Add goal</button></form><ul>${rows}</ul><h2>Recently trashed</h2><ul>${restore}</ul></section>`, css: `.goals-board { display: grid; gap: 12px; } .goals-board h2 { margin: 8px 0; font-size: 20px; } .goal-create { display: flex; align-items: end; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .goal-create label { display: grid; flex: 1 1 190px; gap: 4px; } .goal-create input { width: 100%; } .goals-board ul { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding-left: 20px; } .goals-board li { padding: 5px 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid #b6c0b6; } .goals-board li form { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-left: 8px; }` };"}
```
